newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS pays $5.8 mln to state, feds.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS pays $5.8 mln to state, feds.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said Tuesday it paid about $5.8 million to settle an investigation by state and federal agencies over certain Horizon/CMS Medicare billings.

The company said the settlement with the United States Attorney's office for the District of New Mexico and the Department of Health and Human Services ends the investigation into its Part B and related co-insurance Medicare billings.
The company said the United States is declining any criminal prosecution and will not exclude Horizon/CMS from Medicare and Medicaid programs.
Horizon/CMS, a specialty health care services provider that operates in at least 35, said the $5.8 million it paid includes $1.2 million refunded to the United States in April.
The company said it also will begin a corporate-wide Medicare Part B compliance program as part of the settlement.
Horizon/CMS runs 33 acute rehabilitation hospitals, 58 specialty hospitals, 282 outpatient rehabilitation clinics and 1,800 rehabilitation therapy contracts.
